packages.title: The Riftbreaker
packages.description: The Riftbreaker is a base-building, survival game with action-RPG elements developed by EXOR Studios. Players control Captain Ashley S. Nowak, an elite scientist and commando operating a heavily armed mecha-suit nicknamed Mr. Riggs as she explores the hostile alien planet Galatea 37 to establish a two-way portal back to Earth

packages.title: Resident Evil Requiem Deluxe Edition
packages.description: Resident Evil: Requiem is a classic survival horror experience that intertwines the journeys of FBI intelligence analyst Grace Ashcroft and legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Players navigate abandoned hotels, a zombie-infested clinic, and the ruins of Raccoon City, switching freely between first- and third-person perspectives to solve puzzles and manage resources

packages.title: PRAGMATA Deluxe Edition
packages.description: Developed by Capcom, Pragmata is a sci-fi action-adventure game that follows an Earth engineer named Hugh Williams and an android girl named Diana. The duo is stranded on a hostile lunar research station and must work together to survive rogue AI, defeat robotic enemies, and find a way back to Earth.

packages.title: Crimson Desert Deluxe Edition
packages.description: The Crimson Desert Deluxe Edition is an open-world action-adventure game by Pearl Abyss. You play as Kliff, a mercenary on a quest to rebuild his fallen faction and restore balance to the war-torn continent of Pywel. The Deluxe Edition includes the full game and digital/physical bonus content to aid your journey.

packages.title: Spirit of The North Enhanced Edition
packages.description: Spirit of the North: Enhanced Edition is a visually remastered third-person adventure game set in breathtaking, Iceland-inspired landscapes. You play as an ordinary red fox whose story becomes intertwined with the Guardian of the Northern Lights. Together, you journey through a ruined land to solve environmental puzzles and uncover the mysteries of an ancient civilization

packages.title: The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: the Amulet of Chaos
packages.description: The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos is a humorous, turn-based tactical RPG adapted from the beloved French audio series Le Donjon de Naheulbeuk. Players control a bumbling, mismatched party of stereotypical fantasy adventurers exploring a chaotic dungeon in search of a fabled statuette

packages.title: Red Dead Redemption
packages.description: Red Dead Redemption is a critically acclaimed 2010 action-adventure game by Rockstar Games set during the decline of the American frontier in 1911. Players control John Marston, a former outlaw coerced by government agents into hunting down his old gang members in exchange for his kidnapped family

packages.title: Aeterna Noctis
packages.description: Aeterna Noctis is a hand-drawn, 2D Metroidvania developed by Aeternum Game Studios. Players control the immortal King of Darkness on an epic quest across 16 connected regions to regain his lost powers and defeat the Queen of Light in an eternal, divinely cursed war.

packages.title: Immortals of Aveum
packages.description: Immortals of Aveum is a single-player, story-driven, first-person magic shooter. Players control Jak, a rare Triarch mage who discovers the ability to wield all three colors of combat magic. He joins an elite order of battlemages to stop a massive, world-ending conflict known as the Everwar

packages.title: Star Wars Dark Forces Remaster
packages.description: Star Wars: Dark Forces Remaster is a modern, visually enhanced revival of the groundbreaking 1995 first-person shooter. Developed by Nightdive Studios using their proprietary KEX engine, the remaster offers up to 4K resolution at 120FPS, modernized gamepad controls, improved accessibility, and behind-the-scenes content

packages.title: RollerCoaster Tycoon Adventures Deluxe
packages.description: RollerCoaster Tycoon Adventures Deluxe is a streamlined theme park simulator developed by Graphite Lab and Nvizzio Creations, and published by Atari.

packages.title: The King of Fighters XV
packages.description: The King of Fighters XV (KOF XV) is a 2022 3D fighting game developed by SNK. It continues the legendary arcade series with fast-paced, 3-on-3 team battles, a 39-character base roster, rollback netcode for smooth online matchmaking, and deep mechanics

FINAL FANTASY TACTICS The Ivalice Chronicles
packages.description: With improved graphics, fully voiced dialogue, and refined gameplay, the enhanced version provides the perfect way to immerse yourself in the world of Ivalice. Along with the fine-tuning of several features and battle mechanics, the inclusion of the more accessible 'Squire' difficulty setting makes the enhanced version an excellent starting point for first-time players. The classic version unites the graphics and gameplay of the original 1997 version with the renowned War of the Lions translation for a unique way to experience this beloved title.

packages.title: Stellar Blade
packages.description: Stellar Blade is a single-player, story-driven action-adventure game developed by SHIFT UP and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Players control a soldier named EVE who is tasked with reclaiming a post-apocalyptic Earth from an alien threat known as the Naytiba

packages.title: ASTRO BOT
packages.description: ASTRO BOT is a critically acclaimed 3D action platformer. Players control a brave little robot navigating over 50 vibrant planets to rescue his scattered crew, rebuild his crashed PS5-shaped mothership, and battle cosmic foes

packages.title: Saints Row
packages.description: Saints Row (2022) for the PlayStation 5 is a complete franchise reboot that follows a group of four young friends starting their own outlaw gang. As the future Boss, you, along with Neenah, Kevin, and Eli, will form The Saints to build a criminal empire and battle rival factions across the city
